# Quaternius packs (CC0)

Low-poly models by Quaternius (https://quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 public domain (see `License.txt`).

- Ultimate Animated Animals (July 2021): `art/incoming/quaternius/animals/*.gltf`
  12 models: Alpaca, Bull, Cow, Deer, Donkey, Fox, Horse, Horse_White, Husky, ShibaInu, Stag, Wolf.
  Self-contained glTF (buffers embedded, colours in materials, no textures).
  Animations: Idle, Idle_2, Idle_Headlow / Idle_2_HeadLow, Idle_HitReact1/2, Walk, Gallop, Gallop_Jump,
  Jump_toIdle, Eating, Death, Attack_Headbutt + Attack_Kick (hoofed) or Attack (fox, husky, shiba, wolf).
